role: External blind confirmation of SCC-v1 on ISPRS Vaihingen (untouched_external_confirmation)

blind.declaration: Vaihingen GT is never opened before every region prediction is computed and persisted; the evaluate phase requires the predict-phase manifest and prediction artifact hashes, then reads GT only to score frozen predictions. SAM3 weak-supervision runs with all-positive image-level labels (no GT-derived weak labels).
blind.weak_label_rule: SAM3 prompt-driven candidates with all-positive image-level assumption; no GT pixel, no GT-derived image tags used in predict phase
blind.untouched_audit: reports/vaihingen_untouched_audit_20260818.md: no prior use in this paper's method development; no SCC/C1/C2 metrics ever computed on Vaihingen before this run

split.train_role: weak visual prototype support only (SAM3 weak labels)
split.test_role: blind region-level evaluation with official GT

gt_encoding.clutter_rule: clutter pixels (red) are treated as ignore; they never vote and labeled regions whose mask contains only clutter are unlabeled
gt_encoding.region_label_rule: majority vote of class-color pixels inside the SAM3 candidate mask; ignore pixels never vote

model.identity: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 quick-GELU; OpenCLIP/timm converted state_dict

sam3.prompting: remoteclip_b2c, include_manual_prompts, max 4 prompts per class
sam3.role: frozen proposal generator; candidates are the region proposals and their SAM3 class ids are the weak source labels

group_a_templates: a region of {class} viewed from above

strategy.visual_prototype: L2 normalize cached float32 train-area rows for each SAM3 source label, arithmetic mean, then L2 normalize each class prototype
strategy.text_prototype: L2 normalize each fixed Group A prompt embedding (class names replaced by Vaihingen vocabulary), arithmetic mean by class, then L2 normalize each class prototype
strategy.scc_formula: b(x) = mean_{c in Supported}[A_c(x) - T_c(x)]; supported S_c(x) = A_c(x) - b(x); unsupported S_c(x) = T_c(x); |S|=0 -> Text-only; all supported -> C2
strategy.prediction_rule: argmax over the full 5-class vocabulary, no threshold
strategy.development_label_use: SAM3 source label only for one visual prototype per registered class

partial_support.enumeration: all 2^5 = 32 support subsets (5 classes; non-trivial k=1..4)
partial_support.subset_generation: deterministic bitmask enumeration, no GT-based selection

evaluation.H_aggregation: mean over subsets of per-subset H (mean(H_i)); not H(mean(S), mean(U))
evaluation.ignore_rule: regions with zero class-color pixels inside their mask are unlabeled and excluded; same valid set for all methods
